greeting: Good morning, Rick! Happy Friday, and Black Friday deals are already rolling in, so grab a coffee and take a look.

items.title: Anthropic is now a public company worth more than $1 trillion
items.note: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI assistant, started trading on the stock market Thursday in the largest IPO in Wall Street history. Its stock opened 34 percent above the offering price and briefly valued it at over $2 trillion.

items.title: iOS 27 gave AirPods Pro a convenient new setting, here's how to use it
items.note: With your AirPods in, open Control Center, tap the volume slider, then Listening Mode. When Adaptive is picked, a new slider lets you tune how much outside sound you hear.

items.title: Apple TV is now $6.99/month (50% off) for Black Friday
items.note: New and returning subscribers can get Apple TV for $6.99 a month for up to six months, half the usual $14.99. You have to sign up by Monday, November 30, and you can cancel anytime.

items.title: Google's latest home page redesign makes Gemini even more prominent
items.note: Google Search's AI mode on computers now has a pull-out sidebar that shows your recent searches so you can jump back to one. You may spot it on your Chromebook soon.

items.title: Uber Is Testing Rides for Kids With Qualified Drivers
items.note: Uber is trying out Uber Kids, which lets approved adults book rides for kids ages 10 to 12. The test starts in three cities, including Austin, and could grow if it goes well.

items.title: NASA's new Moon plans have a problem: Orion wasn't designed to fly this way
items.note: NASA reshuffled its Artemis Moon plans to make things easier for the SpaceX and Blue Origin landers. The catch is that the Orion capsule now has to fly in ways it was never built for.

items.title: Mouse fight club might explain why we like to watch violent things
items.note: In a study in Nature, mice that just watched other mice fight did better in their own scraps than mice that never watched. A fun one for a former coach: watching film really does help a little.

items.title: The Funniest GTA 6 Memes Are Running Full Throttle
items.note: Grand Theft Auto 6 came out Thursday as the most preordered video game ever, and the internet went wild with jokes. Even if you haven't played a game since Frogger, these are good for a laugh.
